page.text:
The abstract naturals are any set carrying a distinguished element $0$
and a successor operation obeying the Peano axioms: zero is not a
successor, successor is injective, and the set is generated from zero by
repeated succession. This last condition is the principle of mathematical
induction, and it is what makes the naturals rigid enough to be unique up
to relabeling.
